method:
R4 assembly order and swept-insertion interference check (review M1 fix 4).

Every rigid part (or rigid board assembly) is moved along its insertion direction from a start pose
L mm outside to its final pose. The exact swept volume is A(start) U A(final) U prisms of every boundary
face of A(start) extruded by L along the direction (faces parallel to the direction add nothing).
Each piece is intersected (OCC BRepAlgoAPI_Common) with every already-installed solid; a common volume
>1e-4 mm3 is an interference. Designed elastic snaps are listed explicitly and pass only if their
interference depth across the deflection axis stays within the designed hook overlap.
Thin flexible items (FPCs, RF coax) are not swept; they are checked at the final pose by the pairwise
collision check in build_mechanics.py.
orientation: Cover subassembly built roof-down: parts move world +Z (toward the roof). Cup subassembly built upright: parts move world -Z. Then cup subassembly moves +Z into cover; finished module moves -Z into the instrument cavity.
cover_light_model: upper cover checked without the 0.15 mm top legends (legends are >=0.3 mm from every opening, checked separately)

order.description: 5 keys inserted from inside, stem through Ø5.2, flange into recess
3 light pipes from inside, flange under roof
speaker LS901 into roof pocket (rim to pocket ceiling)
control (cover) board with switches, wheels, LEDs; 2 roof pins locate
PET backer films under keys 1-2 and speaker
key backer bracket + 2 M1.6 screws (clamps control board)
USB board onto 4 roof posts (J401 into tight roof opening)
USB bracket + 3 M1.6 screws (board clamped between bracket and 4 roof posts)
audio board with 4 Kycon jacks, shoulders to roof pads
audio frame snaps over south blade lips and hangs on key-backer ledge / USB-bracket rail
main board assembly snaps under 4 latch teeth
closed cup subassembly pushed into cover subassembly (4 zero-play snaps); FPCs pre-soldered and folded, coax mated
module lowered into instrument cavity, 4 ST2.2 wood screws
